    },
    {
      "login": "vicjuma",

    },
    {
      "login": "polespinasa",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; questioned rescan scope beyond the block prefix and performance metrics"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:5234820518",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "-walletnotify is invoked a second time for unchanged transactions during full second scan passes",
      "quote": "The second walk also re-runs -walletnotify. AddToWallet notifies on every call, so the script fires again for transactions that did not change",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "accepted the prefix-bounded re-scan in commit 278564b",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5262264789"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5264417632",
      "status_by_quote": "ACK 278564b95c0607fd54892d42a60a001e6b32a236"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5041935034",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "If a child tx spends a lookahead parent later in the block, prefix rescan misses the child and leaves the parent output classified as unspent",
      "quote": "The parent output can remain classified as unspent, leaving the wallet balance incorrect until another rescan.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author confirmed the limitation and documented it as a follow-up in the description",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5457594935"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5457594935",
      "status_by_quote": "I'd like to treat this the same way — documenting it as a second known limitation rather than expanding this fix."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3872661031",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Avoid calling collect_range_ends() when SyncTransaction() returns false",
      "quote": "We can avoid some calls to collect_range_ends() by checking the return value of SyncTransaction().",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "implemented in 1d9de0e6",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5457638606",
        "rc:3883805239"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3883892813",
      "status_by_quote": "Done."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3872753832",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Use std::move when assigning cur to range_ends",
      "quote": "range_ends = std::move(cur);",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "implemented in 1d9de0e6",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5457638606",
        "rc:3883736747"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3883892059",
      "status_by_quote": "Done."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3872872400",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Combine the initial scan and prefix rescans into a single loop using scan_end as the bound",
      "quote": "The initial full-block scan and the subsequent prefix rescans can be combined by using scan_end as the exclusive upper bound",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "consolidated into a single loop in 1d9de0e6",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5457638606",
        "rc:3883858331",
        "rc:3883893881"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3883893881",
      "status_by_quote": "Done, thanks!"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5459727026",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "A cascading receive past scan_end that becomes wallet-relevant only after the prefix pass recovers an earlier tx is missed, leaving the wallet balance short",
      "quote": "A receive only becomes the wallet's once the prefix pass recovers an earlier one, and it sits past scan_end. The balance comes out 0.00050000 short.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6019329096",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Why only rescan the block prefix rather than entire or multiple previous blocks, and what is the accepted performance-loss metric?",
      "quote": "This PR proposes the prefix of the block, why not 1 entire block? Why not N previous blocks? Which is the accepted performance-loss metric?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],

      "substantive": true,

    {
      "id": "c:6019329096",

      "reason": "I think this is a nice patch and the only re-check the pre-fix is clean and optimum.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "respond to jeanpablojp's objection regarding cascading receives past scan_end and answer polespinasa's questions",
      "id": "c:5459727026"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added participants vicjuma and polespinasa. vicjuma Concept ACKed and noted the PR description is stale. polespinasa gave a Concept ACK while raising questions regarding the scope and performance boundaries of rescanning."
}
